assembly_goal: Build a runnable true-first-person shooter vertical slice in the abandoned prison arena with visible avatar arms and rifle.
acceptance_criteria: Final project launches into the prison arena
Player movement, aiming, firing, timed reloading, health, and ammunition work
The local full-body player remains enabled while only obstructing head geometry is hidden
The supplied avatar arms and supplied rifle remain visible and attached in first person
Camera-center crosshair and hitscan direction agree
Three enemies pursue, attack, take damage, and die
Victory, defeat, pause, and restart flows work
HUD and menus later reflect the stable mechanic state without covering the arms or rifle
A replayable deterministic trace and demonstration outputs are included

assembly_goal: Build a runnable third-person free-driving exploration slice in the native stylized countryside without converting it into a race course.
acceptance_criteria: The final project launches into the native stylized countryside
The supplied car is visible at plausible scale and starts at a validated open location without intersecting walls, houses, props, water, or steep terrain
The player can accelerate, brake, reverse, steer, handbrake, orbit the camera, pause, resume, and safely reset
The player can freely explore the map without a forced route
The environment is not converted into a closed race track and contains no laps, checkpoints, opponents, countdown, ranking, victory, or defeat flow
The chase camera avoids scenery clipping and keeps the car and forward path readable
The HUD shows only exploration-relevant state and does not cover the car or immediate driving path
A deterministic demonstration drives away from spawn, turns, brakes, pauses, resumes, and completes a safe reset
